### Night

1. Cleanse with the same gentle cleanser.
2. On two evenings a week initially, replace—not follow—the gentle cleanser with Minimalist Salicylic Acid + LHA 2% Cleanser.

The salicylic cleanser is formulated for oily, acne-prone skin. Salicylic acid can help with clogged pores and mild pimples; starting less frequently lets you assess dryness and irritation. If comfortable, gradually increase frequency. If your skin becomes tight, flaky or irritated, reduce use and return to gentle cleansing. [aad](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/skin-care-secrets/face/treat-large-pores)

### What to avoid—and when to get help

- Do not add a salicylic acid serum, exfoliating toner and scrub to this routine at the same time.

- See a dermatologist for deep, painful acne, scarring, or persistent breakouts. A cleanser-only routine may not be enough; treatments such as benzoyl peroxide or a topical retinoid may be needed. Do not self-start retinoids during pregnancy or while trying to conceive. [aad](https://www.aad.org/news/updated-guidelines-acne-management)

You do not need a separate “pore-closing” toner or a niacinamide serum to start.
